name: cut green oak tree
description: a large, cut, green tree with light gray, scaly bark
details: A large tree, felled and cut cleanly through at the base, stretched out full length across the ground.  The cut face shows tight growth rings of light brown heartwood ringed by paler, nearly white sapwood.  Its bark is light gray and scaly with shallow fissures.  The wood is still green and heavy with sap, and wilting leaves, bright yellow-green, oblong and seven-lobed, still cling to the twigs.
keywords: cut green oak tree cut tree green tree felled tree large tree light gray scaly bark shallow fissures oblong seven lobed leaves green wood
